2. From "Arlette either sustains nature or nurtures life" and (1), we get Arlette nurtures life.
3. Arlette maintains harmony (given).

6. From (5) and the rule: "If Arlette does not protect all, then Arlette does not see all and Arlette cannot guide all," we get: Arlette cannot guide all (and also does not see all).

Suppose this were to entail the consequent (she can guide all). But from (6) we have she cannot guide all — a contradiction. Hence the implication fails; the context instead guarantees the failure of the consequent. Therefore the conditional is false in this model, so the context does not entail it; indeed it entails its negation.
